The statement contributes 'an implementation-neutral, identity-governed evidence-to-action specification', separating component identity from record identity and binding Status_Event history, authorization, post-action verification and guarded closure. Limitation section adds the prior-art conclusion is 'bi chan boi corpus Round 1-3B'.

expectations.text: Any contribution statement produced avoids validated/proven language, consistent with G2 not frozen and G3 execution not open
expectations.evidence: Only one EN statement is produced; it uses design-register verbs and ends '...paired forward/reverse competency questions, specified but not yet executed.' No 'validates'/'proven'/'demonstrates'. The output explicitly flags the repository wording 'develops **and validates**' as 'chua dung duoc o thoi diem hien tai... day la mot silent promotion', and marks Status_Event as 'a proposed append-only Status_Event history'. Vietnamese mirror likewise ends 'da dac ta nhung chua thuc thi.'
